title: The hole that opens
starting_code:
# Walk to the hole's edge with `move_right`.

# Wait while the hole is open, with `while` and `wait`.

# Cross it.
hints: Walk 2 right to stop at the edge. Do not step on the hole!
Use `while not` with `hole.closed`, and a wait underneath, to wait while it is not closed. You can also use `while` with `hole.open`, which is exactly the same.
Once the `while` loop ends, the hole is closed, so walk 3 right to the arch!
intro: Careful where you step! Three cells away there is one of those holes that open in the floor. The mark is on the other side, in the storeroom's arch. We will wait while it is open, and then cross!
outro: Safe on the other side! We are at the door of a dark storeroom.
learned: Now you know that `while not` waits for something that is not yet true, and that `hole.closed` says when it is; `hole.open` says the opposite.
